```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

The data contains daily weather records from New York weather stations. It has `r (nrow(ny_noaa))` rows and `r (ncol(ny_noaa))` columns. Important variables include precipitation (tents of mm), snowfall (mm), snow depth (mm), minimum and maximum temperature (tents of degrees C), date of observation, and weather station ID. The data shows a specific station at a date in time from `r min(ny_noaa$date)` to `r max(ny_noaa$date)` across a number of `r n_distinct(ny_noaa$id)` stations.

(missing data)

```{r}
noaa_clean <- ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    day = day(date),
    prcp = prcp / 10,                  #changing tenths of mm to mm#
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,      #changing tenths of degree C to degree C#
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,      #changing tenths of degree C to degree C#
  )
```

```{r}
snow_fall <- noaa_clean |>
  count(snow, sort = TRUE)

```

For snowfall, the most commonly observed value is `r snow_fall$snow[1]` mm. This is because it does not snow often during the year such as during the summer, spring, and fall seasons. The next most commonly observed value is `r snow_fall$snow[2]` mm. This is because there are no data recorded for snow fall at a particular station. The next most observed value of snowfall is non-zero at `r snow_fall$snow[3]` mm.

```{r}
tmax_avg <- noaa_clean |>
  filter(month == 1 | month == 7) |>
  mutate(month_name = factor(month, levels = c(1,7), labels = c("January", "July"))) |>
  group_by(id, year, month_name) |>
  summarise(mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
tmax_avg |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_tmax, group = id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = .5) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5) +
  facet_grid(. ~ month_name) +
  labs(
    title = "Average daily maximum temperature by station in January vs July",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Maximum Temperature(C) ",
    caption = "NOAA Data"
  )
```


```{r}
tmax_tmin <- noaa_clean |>
  drop_na(tmax, tmin) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 60) +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(trans = "sqrt", name = "Count") +
  labs(
    title = "tmax vs tmin",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maximum daily temperature (C)"
  )

snow_year <- noaa_clean |>
  filter(snow > 0, snow < 100) |>
  mutate(year = factor(year)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = snow, y = year)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = .85) +
  labs(
    title = "Snowfall Distribution by Year",
    x = "Snowfall (mm)",
    y = "Year"
  )

tmax_tmin + snow_year
```
